scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Ah...
I know those eyes.
Full of compassion
...and courage.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
啊...
我认得这双眼睛。
充满了怜悯
...还有勇气。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Of course you're a volunteer for campaign to reclaim the Prontera Culvert. Would you let me warp you there?
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
当然，你是为了收复普隆德拉下水道战役而自愿参军的。需要我传送你过去吗？

scripts.text: Warp to Culvert Entrance.
scripts.translation: 传送到下水道入口

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Ah, let me inform you that the Capital Defense Headquarter of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom has now decided to recruit a punitive force due to the Prontera Culvert's situation.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
啊，请允许我告知你，由于普隆德拉下水道目前的状况，卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都防卫总部已决定招募一支惩戒部队。

scripts.text: Volunteer.
scripts.translation: 自愿参军

scripts.text: Situation...?
Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Are you ready, hero?
I will now warp you
to the Culvert.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你准备好了吗，英雄？
我现在就传送你
去下水道。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Haven't you heard...?
The Prontera Culvert is infested with all kinds of filthy vermin!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你没听说过吗...？
普隆德拉下水道里到处都是各种肮脏的害虫！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Due to the serious risk of water contamination, and the safety of Rune-Midgartsians, the Culvert has been quarantined by royal decree.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
由于存在严重的水源污染风险，为了卢恩·米德加兹人民的安全，下水道已根据王室法令被隔离。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Needless to say, this has caused shortages in the water supply in our kingdom. Indeed, such a crisis in these dark times...
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
不用说，这导致了我们王国的供水短缺。确实，在这黑暗的时代，这样的危机...

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Our people
thirst for water...
But they thirst
even more...
For a hero!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
我们的人民
渴望水...
但他们更渴望...
一位英雄！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Will you stand idly as the children of Rune-Midgarts suffer from parched throats and shed tears of dryness?! Would you bury our children?!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
难道你要袖手旁观，看着卢恩·米德加兹的孩子们因喉咙干渴而流泪吗？！难道你要埋葬我们的孩子吗？！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Warriors! Rune-Midgarts is calling you! Cleanse this land's pestilence and cast out the vermin in the Culvert! Only you... Can make a difference.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
战士们！卢恩·米德加兹在呼唤你们！清除这片土地的瘟疫，驱逐下水道里的害虫！只有你...才能带来改变。

scripts.text: Volunteer.
scripts.translation: 自愿参军

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Adventurer...
I will now warp you
to the Prontera Culvert.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
冒险者...
我现在就传送你
去普隆德拉下水道。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Hmpf. Well. The next time you take a drink of water, just remember that an average of nine and a half children just died... ^990000Of thirst^000000.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
哼。好吧。下次你喝水的时候，请记住平均有九个半的孩子刚刚... ^990000因口渴而死^000000。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Your registration...
is now complete.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
你的登记...
现已完成。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
I would like to thank you for volunteering to do your part for our great kingdom. Here, take these provisions for your battles against the forces of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
我想感谢你自愿为我们的伟大王国尽一份力。拿着，这些补给品将帮助你在对抗黑暗势力的战斗中。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
3 Red Potions, 1 Milk,
and 1 Orange Potion
...to give you hope.
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
3瓶红色药水，1瓶牛奶，
和1瓶赤色药水
...给你希望。

scripts.text:
[Culvert Guardian]
Ah, you're one of our volunteers. This is the entrance of the Prontera Culvert.
Do you wish to
go inside?
scripts.translation:
[下水道守卫]
啊，你是我们的志愿者之一。这里是普隆德拉下水道的入口。
你想进去吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Culvert Guardian]
I'm sorry, but we can only allow volunteers for the Culvert Campaign to enter.
scripts.translation:
[下水道守卫]
很抱歉，我们只允许下水道战役的志愿者进入。

scripts.text:
[Culvert Guardian]
If you'd like to volunteer, please visit the ^000077Culvert Registrar^000000 located in the 11 O'clock direction of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[下水道守卫]
如果您想成为志愿者，请前往普隆德拉11点钟方向的^000077下水道登记处^000000。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
Oh...
Those Flowers in your hand are...
scripts.translation:
[老师]
哦...
你手中的那些花是...

scripts.text: Show Flowers
scripts.translation: 展示花朵

scripts.text: Present Flowers
scripts.translation: 赠送花朵

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
Ah...
Those are definitely the 4 kinds of Flowers I was looking for! Would you give them to me?
scripts.translation:
[老师]
啊...
那确实是我正在寻找的4种花！你愿意把它们给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
If you would...
I'll give you my precious item.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
如果你愿意...
我会把珍贵的物品送给你。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
I really really appreciate you what you've done for me. I'm truly grateful. I will give my precious item to you as promised.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
我非常非常感激你为我所做的一切。我真心感谢。我会遵守承诺，把珍贵的物品送给你。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
This is the Hat I've worn on my Graduation from my University. It reminds me of my happy school days. Please take this...
scripts.translation:
[老师]
这是我大学毕业时戴的帽子。它让我想起了快乐的校园时光。请收下这个...

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
... Oh, I'm Sorry.
But that's not what I'm looking for. Maybe you need to study flowers a little bit?
scripts.translation:
[老师]
...哦，对不起。
但这并不是我在找的东西。也许你需要多研究一下花卉？

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
Don't you think...
Flowers are pretty?
scripts.translation:
[老师]
你不觉得...
花很美吗？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
When I was young,
I had no friends and
studied all the time.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
小时候，
我没有朋友，
一直在学习。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
Sometimes I regret what I did when I was younger, but it's not a big deal now. Through hard study, I finished entire educational courses earlier than all the other students.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
有时我会后悔年轻时的所作所为，但现在这已经不重要了。通过刻苦学习，我比其他所有学生都更早完成了整个课程。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
However...
I was sad and sometimes lonely. Whenever the studying got too hard, I needed someone who would listen to me. Finally, one day, I met my best friend.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
然而...
我感到悲伤，有时也很孤独。每当学习变得太艰难时，我都需要一个能倾听我的人。终于有一天，我遇到了我最好的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
When I saw a Pretty Flower blooming in the abandoned Garden, I realized It was my friend which shared my fate.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
当我看到一朵美丽的花在废弃的花园中绽放时，我意识到它就是与我命运相连的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
Although it is a Common and Normal Flower to others, she gave me the reason to study again. I could achieve my goals because of her.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
虽然对别人来说，它只是一朵普通的花，但它给了我再次学习的理由。正是因为有了它，我才得以实现我的目标。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
So recently...
I am trying to pay her back. Now I am studying Flowers, and plan to over the whole world with them.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
所以最近...
我正试图回报它。现在我正在研究花卉，并计划用它们覆盖整个世界。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
To accomplish my work...
I need bunches of flowers. But for someone who rarely goes outside, it is really hard to find all the flowers I need.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
为了完成我的工作...
我需要成束的花朵。但对于一个很少出门的人来说，找到我需要的所有花真的很难。

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
I need 1 ^3355FFIllusion Flower^000000 ,1 ^3355FFHinalle^000000,1 ^3355FFAloe^000000 and 1 ^3355FFMent^000000. If you can bring them to me, I'd give you my treasure...
scripts.translation:
[老师]
我需要1朵^3355FF幻想花^000000，1朵^3355FF西纳雷花^000000，1朵^3355FF芦荟^000000和1朵^3355FF薄荷^000000。如果你能带给我，我会把我的宝物送给你...

scripts.text:
[Teacher]
One of these days I will cover this whole world with Flowers.
scripts.translation:
[老师]
总有一天，我会用花朵覆盖整个世界。

you know that?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

a graceful and considerate
lady, you woulda helped me

scripts.translation:

是啊...如果你是一位优雅体贴的女士，
之前就会帮我的忙了。我说得对吧？

scripts.text:

kick over one of the
piles of books next

scripts.translation:
^3355FF你本能地踢倒了男孩旁边的一摞书。
你无法控制自己：
这是自然的反射动作！^000000

scripts.text:

Ack! Those books...!
It took me so long to
stack all of those!
scripts.translation:
[忙碌的男孩]
啊！那些书...！
我花了好久才把它们堆好的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no, what a mess!
Here, let me help you
arrange these nicely
out of the bottom of
my freakin' heart.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀，真是一团糟！
来，让我帮你把这些书整理好，

scripts.text:

...
......

Oh, thanks for
helping me out here.

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: 这些都是你的吗？

to deliver these for my job.
I need to take these to Juno
from the Prontera Library
for a client. However, um...
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Well...
I get motion sick really
easily, so it scares me to
death to ride the Airship
all the way to Juno.
scripts.translation:

嗯...
我很容易晕车，
所以坐飞空艇去朱诺让我吓得要死。

scripts.text:
[Busy-Looking Boy]
Now I'm in trouble!
I'm never late, but this
time I just can't help it.
There's nothing I can do!
Oh, I'm gonna lose this job!
scripts.translation:

我要丢掉这份工作了！

scripts.text:

do a lot of traveling, right?
If you're traveling to Juno,
would you please deliver this
for me? I'll be in real trouble
if I don't send these books...
scripts.translation:

如果你要去朱诺，
能帮我送一下这些书吗？
如果我不把这些书送出去，我就惨了...

scripts.text:

I-I understand.
It's none of your 
business, I know, but
I'm just so desperate...
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

啊！不行，我做不到！

^333333*Sob...*^000000

for me to deliver his books
for quite a while now...
scripts.translation:

[忙碌的男孩]
哦，请把我给你的那些书
送到^FF0000卡尔莫夫先生^000000那里，
他应该在朱诺图书馆附近等着。
再次感谢你的帮助~

scripts.text: Help him
scripts.translation: 帮助他

scripts.text: Don't help him
scripts.translation: 不帮他

scripts.text:
[Busy-Looking Boy]
Oh, thank you so much!
You don't understand how
much I dread those Airships.
Now, would you please deliver
these books to ^FF0000Mr. Karlomoff^000000
near the Juno Library?
scripts.translation:
[忙碌的男孩]
哦，太感谢你了！
你不知道我有多害怕那些飞空艇。
那么，请帮我把这些书
送到朱诺图书馆附近的
^FF0000卡尔莫夫先生^000000那里好吗？

scripts.text:
[Busy-Looking Boy]
I know these books are
pretty heavy, but be really
careful with them! Anyway,
thanks for doing this for me.
I was really at my wit's end...
scripts.translation:
[忙碌的男孩]
我知道这些书挺重的，
但请一定要小心！
总之，谢谢你帮我这个忙。
我真是走投无路了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Juno's mysterious past
holds some great secret.
I'm sure of it! It excites me
to know that my research
brings me that much closer
to finally unveiling it!
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
朱诺神秘的历史
隐藏着巨大的秘密。
我确信这一点！
知道我的研究让我离
最终揭开真相更近了一步，
这让我兴奋不已！

scripts.text:
[Historian]
But I'll admit that even I don't know how much digging I'll
have to do to learn what I want. It's our duty as historians to
find out the truth of the past, but it definitely won't be easy.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
但我也承认，即使是我也不知道
为了了解我想要知道的，
还需要挖掘多少。作为历史学家，
查明过去的真相是我们的职责，
但这绝对不容易。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
To understand, to see the
truth of the past with my
own eyes... I'd even sell
my soul for the opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
去理解，用我自己的眼睛
看到过去的真相...
为了这个机会，
我甚至愿意出卖灵魂。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you approached, this
historian suddenly closed
the book that he was reading,
looked to the heavens and
let out a deep breath in a vain
attempt to relieve his tension.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你走近时，这位
历史学家突然合上了
正在读的书，
仰望天空，
深吸了一口气，
试图缓解他的紧张。^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian]
GRRRRRRRRR!
Where are my books?!
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
可恶！
我的书在哪里？！

scripts.text: Are you alright?
scripts.translation: 你还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Er? Oh. I'm sorry you
had to see that. I'm just
extremely upset. You see,
I'm expecting a delivery of
research books from Prontera,
but they haven't arrived yet.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
呃？哦。抱歉让你
看到这一幕。我只是
非常沮丧。你看，
我在等从普隆德拉寄来的
研究书籍，但它们还没到。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
In fact, the delivery boy is
very late. This will delay my
research considerably since
I cannot proceed without more
new material to study.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
事实上，送货的男孩迟到了。
没有新的研究材料，
我无法继续研究，
这会让我的研究大大延后。

scripts.text: Excuse me, but what's your name?
scripts.translation: 请问，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Hm? I'm Karlomoff, the
1st scholar of the Rekenber
Historical Research Group.
Did you need something, or
were you looking around here
for somebody in particular?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
嗯？我是卡尔莫夫，
雷肯贝尔历史研究组的第一位学者。
你有事吗？
还是在这里找什么人？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm delivering the books for him.
scripts.translation: 哦，我是给他送书的。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Ah, really?
Great, you're here!
So, where are the books?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
啊，真的吗？
太好了，你终于来了！
那么，书在哪里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I...
I don't have
them right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...
我现在没有带书。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
What...?
Don't tell me that
you lost them! Those
books were priceless!
Did you come all this
way just to tell me that?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
什么...？
不会是你把它们弄丢了吧！
那些书是无价之宝啊！
你大老远跑来就为了告诉我这个？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Well, I suppose you'll
have to report the loss of
the books and get some new
copies of those books that
you were supposed to deliver.
Now hurry, I need to research!
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
好吧，我想你只能
去报告书籍丢失的情况，
并重新获取那些
本该送来的书的副本了。
快去吧，我需要研究！

scripts.text: Right, I brought your books.
scripts.translation: 是的，我带来了你的书。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
What? But you're not the
delivery boy. Well, let me see
the books you've brought. Hm...
Just as I thought: the Rune-
Midgarts Kingdom has a great
wealth of ancient information.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
什么？但你不是送货的男孩啊。
好吧，让我看看你带来的书。嗯...
果然不出我所料：
卢恩·米德加兹王国
拥有大量古代资讯。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Ah, thank you so much for
bringing these. However, by
your mode of dress, I can tell
that you are an adventurer.
What happened to the delivery boy that was supposed to bring these?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
啊，非常感谢你带来这些。
不过，从你的穿着来看，
你是一名冒险者。
本该送这些书的送货男孩怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
..........?
Afraid to ride the Airship?
Motion sickness? Well, that's
quite understandable. The poor
boy should have contacted me
about that beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
..........？
害怕坐飞空艇？
晕车？嗯，这完全可以理解。
那个可怜的孩子应该提前告诉我的。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Goodness, it's been 
a while since I've had
a visitor. Would you like
to stay and chat for a bit?
Just give me a minute to get
a cool drink of water first~
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
天哪，好久没有
访客了。你想留下来
聊一会儿吗？
请给我一分钟，
我去倒杯凉水~

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Ah, that glass of
water was just what
I needed to refresh
myself. Let me tell you
a little bit about my work.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
啊，这杯水
正好让我恢复精神。
让我告诉你
一些关于我工作的事。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
I might have it mentioned before, but my name is Karlomoff and
I work in the Rekenber Historical Research as its 1st scholar. We
recently finished our project on the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
我可能之前提过，我叫卡尔莫夫，
在雷肯贝尔历史研究组担任第一位学者。
我们最近完成了
关于修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的项目。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Now, we're trying to learn
more about the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom's history. We believe
it's linked to our Schwarzwald
Republic because they share the
continent. Makes sense, right?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
现在，我们试图了解
卢恩·米德加兹王国的历史。
我们认为它与我们的
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国有关联，
因为它们共享同一片大陆。
这很合理，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Ultimately, we hope that
new information from our
research of Rune-Midgarts will
shed some new light on our
current understanding of the
Schwarzwald Republic's past.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
最终，我们希望
从卢恩·米德加兹的研究中
获得的新资讯，
能为我们目前对
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
过去的理解带来新的启示。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Including myself, there are
^3131FF3 members of the Rekenber
Historical Research Group^000000
that are studying the Rune-
Midgarts Kingdom's history.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
包括我在内，
^3131FF雷肯贝尔历史研究组共有3名成员^000000
正在研究卢恩·米德加兹王国的历史。

scripts.text: Rekenber Historical Research Group?
scripts.translation: 雷肯贝尔历史研究组？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
You adventurers from Rune-
Midgarts may not know it, but
the Rekenber Corporation has
unofficial control over our
Schwarzwald Republic. Some
hate it, others don't care.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
你们来自卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者
可能不知道，
雷肯贝尔公司
非正式地控制着我们的
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国。
有些人讨厌它，
有些人则毫不在意。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Anyway, Rekenber has its own
Historical Research Group since
rediscovering ancient technologies has been key to its success, well,
so far as I can tell. Personally, I enjoy the pursuit of knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
总之，雷肯贝尔有自己的历史研究组，
因为重新发现古代技术是其成功的关键，
至少据我了解是这样。
就我个人而言，我享受追求知识的过程。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Oh, here's an interesting
fact! Did you know that the
title of ruler of Rune-Midgarts
isn't always passed down
through the same family?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
哦，这里有一个有趣的事实！
你知道吗？
卢恩·米德加兹统治者的头衔
并不总是由同一个家族继承的。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Actually, there are several
royal families that hold a
special competition to decide
which prince becomes the
next king. Fascinating...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
实际上，有几个王室家族
会举行特殊的比赛，
来决定哪位王子将成为下一任国王。
真令人着迷...

scripts.text: Several royal families?
scripts.translation: 几个王室家族？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Yes, I'll try to explain it
briefly. There are a total
of 7 royal families. Each
family is descended from one
of the 7 warriors that founded
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
是的，我试着简要解释一下。
总共有7个王室家族。
每个家族都源自
建立卢恩·米德加兹王国的7位战士之一。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
According to the records,
Jormungand, the snake of the
earth, appeared and brought
chaos to the entire continent.
7 warriors appeared and drove the serpent away, saving the world.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
根据记载，
耶梦加得，大地之蛇，
出现并给整片大陆带来了混沌。
7位战士出现并赶走了巨蛇，拯救了世界。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
With the return of peace,
the 7 warriors established
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
choosing Tristram Geoborg III
as the kingdom's first ruler.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
随着和平的回归，
7位战士建立了卢恩·米德加兹王国，
并选择特里斯特拉姆·吉奥伯格三世
作为王国的第一任统治者。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Knowing that their descendents
may not always be deserving of
ruling the kingdom, the 7 warriors agreed to hold a contest amongst
their families each generation to prevent royal corruption.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
考虑到他们的后代
未必总是配得上统治王国，
7位战士同意每一代都在家族之间举行比赛，
以防止王室腐败。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Oh... Not too excited
about history, huh? Well,
maybe if I sing the ancient
song of this myth, you'd be
better able to understand...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
哦...你对历史不太感兴趣，是吗？
好吧，也许如果我唱一下这个神话的古老歌曲，
你会更容易理解...

scripts.text:
[Historian]
^FF0000*The great serpent*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the sea.*^000000
^FF0000*The eagle of the rainbow*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the serpent.*^000000
^FF0000*Then the eagle built its nest.*^000000
^FF0000*A nest upon the swallowed sea.*^000000

[Historian]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 As you see, I'm
quite tone deaf. But the
point is that people still
praise the 7 warriors' exploits
through this song. Isn't that
interesting to know about?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
^333333*咳咳*^000000 你看，我五音不全。
但重点在于，人们
仍然通过这首歌
赞美7位战士的功绩。
知道这一点不是很有趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
I'm sorry that I let my
mouth run while talking at
great length about Rune-
Midgart's history. Still,
I hope you found that tale
at least a little enjoyable.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
很抱歉我滔滔不绝地
讲述了卢恩·米德加兹的历史。
不过，我希望你觉得
这个故事至少有一点意思。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Oh! Will you be returning to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom?
If so, then I have a favor to
ask you. Would you please
deliver this report I've written to my colleague in Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
哦！你要回卢恩·米德加兹王国吗？
如果是的话，我有一个请求。
请帮我把我写的这份报告
交给我在莫洛克的同事。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
It would be a great help
to me if you could get this
report to her right away.
Ah, her name is Rodafrian.
I'm certain you can find her
somewhere in that desert town.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
如果你能尽快把这份报告
交给她，那将对我帮助很大。
啊，她的名字是罗达夫兰。
我确信你能在那个沙漠城镇的某处找到她。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Please find my colleague,
Rodafrian, in Morocc and
deliver my report to her.
You should be able to find
her there doing research.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
请在莫洛克找到我的同事罗达夫兰，
并把我的报告交给她。
你应该能在那里找到她正在做研究。

scripts.text: I will
scripts.translation: 我会的

scripts.text: Can I listen to that song again?
scripts.translation: 我能再听一遍那首歌吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Once again, thank
you for your help.
It will really speed the
progress of my research,
especially since those books
were delivered fairly late...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
再次感谢你的帮助。
这将大大加快我的研究进度，
尤其是那些书交付得相当晚...

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Song? Oh, you mean the
one praising the 7 who
founded the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom? Sure, let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
歌曲？哦，你是指
那首赞美建立卢恩·米德加兹王国的
7位战士的歌吗？
当然，让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Historian]
^FF0000*The great serpent*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the sea.*^000000
^FF0000*The eagle of the rainbow*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the serpent.*^000000
^FF0000*Then the eagle built its nest.*^000000
^FF0000*A nest upon the swallowed sea.*^000000

[Historian]
You must be more interested
in history than I suspected.
If you'd like, I'll write you a
letter or recommendation
for the Rekenber Historical
Research Group. Ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
看来你对历史的兴趣
比我想象的要大。
如果你愿意，我可以给你写一封
雷肯贝尔历史研究组的推荐信或介绍信。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Historian]
Ah, it's been a while
since the last time I saw
you. Rodafrian actually came
to visit me a few days ago.
I believe she came here
to gloat or threaten me...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
啊，距离上次见到你
已经有一段时间了。
罗达弗里安几天前
还来拜访过我。
我想她来这里
大概是为了炫耀或威胁我...

scripts.text:
[Historian]
It was very surreal.
She kept raving about
some incredible revelation,
and about finally putting me
in my place. I didn't know she
could be so competitive!
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
那感觉非常超现实。
她一直在胡言乱语，
说什么惊人的发现，
还有终于让我认清自己的位置。
我都不知道她
竟然这么有竞争心！

scripts.text:
[Historian]
ZzzzZZz....
ZzzzZZz....ZZZzzzz...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
呼噜呼噜...
呼噜呼噜...呼噜噜噜...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou seem to have lost
Karlomoff's Report. You
needed to deliver here to
one of his colleagues...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你似乎丢失了
卡尔莫夫的调查报告。
你需要把它交给
他的同事之一...

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Oh, how does this place
have to be so hot? This
can't be good for my skin...
Ooh, I wish I were back home
in the Schwarzwald Republic~
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
哦，这里怎么这么热？
这对我的皮肤可不好...
噢，我真想回到
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的家~

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Hello there.
E-excuse me, but,
um, may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
你好。
请...请原谅，但是，
嗯，有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Mr. Karlomoff has sent me.
scripts.translation: 卡尔莫夫先生派我来的。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Karlomoff...?
Him? Alright...
What did he send
you to me for?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
卡尔莫夫...？
是他吗？好吧...
他派你来找我
有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hand Karlomoff's
report to Rodafrian.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你将卡尔莫夫的
调查报告交给了罗达弗里安。^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
A report? What does he
want to show off this time?
^333333*Sigh*^000000 Ah well, thanks for
the trouble. I'll look at it,
though I'm not expecting
much if Karlomoff wrote it.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
报告？他这次又想炫耀什么？
^333333*叹气*^000000 算了，
谢谢你的麻烦。我会看看的，
不过如果是卡尔莫夫写的，
我可不抱太大希望。

scripts.text: Ask her about her research
scripts.translation: 询问她的研究

scripts.text: End conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Oh, you know about the
Rekenber Historical Research
Group? Ah, right. Karlomoff
must have told you already.
Currently we're researching
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
哦，你知道
雷肯贝尔历史研究组吗？
啊，对了。卡尔莫夫
肯定已经告诉过你了。
目前我们正在研究
卢恩·米德加兹王国。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Now, while I understand the
value of ancient books and
records, I think Karlomoff
relies on them too much.
I prefer more active research
in the vein of archaelogy.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
虽然我能理解
古籍和记录的价值，
但我认为卡尔莫夫
太依赖它们了。
我更喜欢像考古那样
更积极的研究方式。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Right now, I'm spending
time in Morocc to visit the
Sphinx and Pyramids and see
if I can excavage some relics.
Hopefully I can uncover some new historical evidence that way.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
目前，我正在摩洛哥
拜访斯芬克斯和金字塔，
看看能否挖掘出一些遗物。
希望能借此发现
新的历史证据。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
If you're interested in
learning more about Morocc's
history, please go ahead and
talk to my assistance. He's very passionate about studying this
town's culture and background.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
如果你对了解
摩洛哥的历史感兴趣，
请尽管去和我的助手谈谈。
他对研究这个城镇的
文化和背景非常热情。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Actually, the people of
Morocc also appreciate their
town's history, and pass down
songs about ancient times
through the generations. Let's
see, how did that one go?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
实际上，摩洛哥的
人们也很珍视他们的
历史，并通过世代相传
歌颂古代的歌曲。让我想想，
那首歌是怎么唱的来着？

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
^FF0000*The great serpent*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the sea.*^000000
^FF0000*The eagle of the rainbow*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the serpent, and*^000000
and... and... Um. Oh dear.

[Historian Rodafrian]
I can't remember the next
line! Actually, have you
heard this song before?
scripts.translation:

我想不起下一句了！
其实，你以前
听过这首歌吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过。

scripts.text: Yes, but it is different.
scripts.translation: 是的，但歌词不同。

scripts.text: No, sorry.
scripts.translation: 不，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Oh, that's great!
Would you provide
me with the line that
follows these lyrics?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
太好了！
你能告诉我
接在这几句歌词后面的
下一句是什么吗？

scripts.text:
^FF0000*The great serpent*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the sea.*^000000
^FF0000*The eagle of the rainbow*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the serpent.*^000000
......................

[Historian Rodafrian]
Really? That makes
sense, but those lyrics
sound different than the
ones I had heard. Hmmmm...
If you don't mind, would you
please tell me your name?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
真的吗？这说得通，
但这些歌词听起来
和我听到的不一样。嗯...
如果不介意的话，
能告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Huh...?
That doesn't sound
right at all. Are you sure
that's the lyric you heard?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
嗯...？
这完全不对啊。
你确定你听到的
就是这句歌词吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
What was that?
The song is different?
Hmm. Then, would you
please sing the version
that you know to me?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
刚才说什么？
歌曲不一样？
嗯。那么，
你能把你听到的版本
唱给我听吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou clear your throat
and begin to sing the song
that you heard from Karlomoff.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你清了清嗓子，
开始唱起从卡尔莫夫那里
听到的那首歌。^000000

scripts.text:

*swallowed the sea.*
scripts.translation:
*伟大的巨蛇*
*吞没了大海。*

scripts.text:

*swallowed the serpent.*
scripts.translation:
*彩虹之鹰*
*吞没了巨蛇。*

scripts.text: *Then the eagle built its nest.*
scripts.translation: *然后鹰筑起了巢。*

scripts.text: *A nest upon the swallowed sea.*
scripts.translation: *巢筑在被吞没的大海上。*

scripts.translation:

如果不介意的话，
能告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text:

at all. Are you sure those
are the lyrics you heard?
scripts.translation:

嗯...？
这完全不对啊。
你确定你听到的
就是这些歌词吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
............
........................
Well then. Would you
mind if I ask you for
your name, adventurer?

[Historian]
Although I love doing my
research and uncovering
new information regarding
history, I feel a little lonely
sometimes. Not many people
share my interests, you know...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
虽然我热爱研究，
并致力于发掘历史的新信息，
但有时我会感到有点孤独。
毕竟，很少有人
和我有相同的兴趣，你知道吗...

scripts.text:
^3355FFArms folded, Rodafrian
seems to be deep in thought.
Then, as if making making
an important decision, she
looks directly into your eyes
and begins to speak.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF罗达弗里安双臂交叉，
似乎陷入了沉思。
然后，仿佛做出了
一个重要的决定，
她直视着你的眼睛，
开始说道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Adventurer...
I want to know your name.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
冒险者...
我想知道你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
As I recall, Mondo should
be at Mount Mjolnir, located
in the northern region of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Ask
him for the lyrics of the song that I can't seem to remember...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
我记得，蒙多应该在
卢恩·米德加兹王国北部的
雷神之锤山上。
请向他询问
我记不起来的那首歌的歌词...

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Oh, you've returned.
Have you met with Mondo
and figured out the lyrics of
that song I was looking for?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
哦，你回来了。
你见到蒙多了吗？
找到我在找的那首歌的歌词了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^FF0000*The great serpent*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the sea.*^000000
^FF0000*The eagle of the rainbow*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the serpent.*^000000
^FF0000*Then snake scales grew on*^000000
^FF0000*the eagle, and it slowly died.*^000000

[Historian Rodafrian]
Oh, yes!
Yes, that was it! Now
I remember, thank you
so much! Ah, back to work...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
哦，是的！
没错，就是那个！
我想起来了，
非常感谢你！
啊，继续工作吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(As a historian, Rodafrian
might be able to help me in
investigating the curse of the
Geoborgs. The priests told me
not to tell anybody, though.
Should I take this risk?)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333(作为历史学家，罗达弗里安
或许能帮我调查
格博格家族的诅咒。
不过，牧师们叮嘱我
不要告诉任何人。
我该冒这个险吗？)^000000

scripts.text: Tell her about Jormungand's curse
scripts.translation: 告诉她关于耶梦加得的诅咒

scripts.text: Don't tell her
scripts.translation: 不告诉她

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou explain everything
that you have learned to
Rodafrian, choosing not
to withhold any secrets.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向罗达弗里安
解释了你所学到的一切，
选择保留任何秘密。^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
.....................!

[Historian Rodafrian]
Thank you for sharing that
with me. I hope you realize
how precious that information
is. I had no idea the royal
family was keeping that kind
of secret. Goodness, me...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
谢谢你告诉我这些。
我希望你意识到
这些信息有多珍贵。
我完全不知道
王室竟然藏着这种秘密。
天哪，我真是...

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
You know, I don't really
know much about poison, but
I do know that, aside from our
own Assassins, there are poison
experts living in some strange
land located to the west.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
你知道吗，
我对毒药并不太了解，
但我知道，除了我们自己的刺客，
在西边某个奇怪的土地上
还住着一些毒药专家。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Anyway, your report about
the Geoborg family will be
greatly appreciated by the
Rekenber Historical Research
Group. But first, I need to
finish this Morocc project...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
总之，你关于格博格家族的报告
一定会受到
雷肯贝尔历史研究小组的赞赏。
不过首先，
我得先完成这个摩洛哥项目...

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Anyway, keep this information
a secret between me and you
for now. Then, when I reveal the secret curse of the Geoborg royal
family, I'll finally outshine that Karlomoff! Bwahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
总之，
目前请把这个信息
只留在我和你之间保密。
然后，当我揭露
格博格王室的秘密诅咒时，
我就能彻底压过那个卡尔莫夫了！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(Drat, she didn't give me
any help... All I did was
reveal a huge secret to her
that she might spread around!
Oh well, I guess I better head
back to the priests...)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333(可恶，她没给我任何帮助...
我只是向她透露了一个大秘密，
她可能会到处宣扬！
算了，我想还是
最好回到牧师那里去...)^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Oh, let me thank you
once again for going
through the trouble of
getting that lyric for me~
I put my assistant through
enough trouble already...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
哦，让我再次感谢你
费心帮我找到那首歌词~
我已经让助手
够辛苦了...

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
I also better not forget
to go through Karlomoff's
report. I'll have to have a
debate with him sooner or
later, and I really want to
put that guy in his place!
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
我也不能忘记
去审阅卡尔莫夫的报告。
迟早我要和他辩论一番，
我真的想
让那个人吃点苦头！

scripts.text:
^3355FFRodafrian seemed very
happy and began to read
through Karlomoff's report.
For now, it would be best
to return to Father Bamph.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF罗达弗里安看起来非常高兴，
开始阅读卡尔莫夫的报告。
目前，
最好回到班夫神父那里。^000000

scripts.text:

I just paid a visit to
Karlomoff and gave him
a piece of my mind! I think...
I think I put him in his place.
But I can never really tell
with that sneaky guy...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
我刚去拜访了卡尔莫夫，
狠狠地教训了他一顿！
我想...

我永远无法确定...

with that sneaky guy...

我刚去拜访了卡尔莫夫，
狠狠地教训了他一顿！
我想...
我想让他认清自己的位置了。
但面对那个狡猾的家伙，
我永远无法确定...

scripts.text:
It doesn't look like
Rodafrian can offer you
any more information. For
now, it would be best to
go to ^3355FFProntera Church.^000000
scripts.translation:
看起来罗达弗里安
无法再为你提供更多信息了。
目前，
最好去^3355FF普隆德拉教堂。^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
I'm sorry, but I'm
really very busy with my
research at the moment.
Perhaps we can talk later
once I've completed this?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
很抱歉，
我现在正忙于研究。
也许等我完成这个之后，
我们再谈？

scripts.text: My name is {0}.
scripts.translation: 我的名字是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Ah {0}, eh?
Do you mind if I ask you a favor? I really need to verify the true
lyrics for this song. However,
I need to stay here in Morocc
to complete my research.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
啊，{0}，是吗？
你能帮我一个忙吗？
我真的很需要核实这首歌的真实歌词。
不过，
我必须留在莫洛奇完成我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
Would you please find my
colleague Mondo and ask him
for this song's lyrics? You can
find him in the ancient ruins
in Mount Mjolnir, north in the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
请你去找找我的同事蒙多，
问问他这首歌的歌词好吗？
他在卢恩·米德加兹王国北部的
雷神之锤山（Mount Mjolnir）的
古代遗迹里。

scripts.text:
[Historian Rodafrian]
I apologize for asking
you to do what sounds like
a silly errand, but I actually
need to know this song's lyrics
for the sake of my research...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 罗达弗里安]
抱歉让你去办这种听起来很傻的跑腿活，
但我确实需要知道这首歌的歌词，
为了我的研究...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Excuse me...
But if you don't have
anything important for
me, then would you
please leave? I have
research to attend to...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
打扰一下...
如果你没有重要的事情
要找我，
请离开好吗？
我有研究要忙...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but Ms. Rodafrian
wanted me to ask you for the
lyrics of some song describing
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom's
founding. Would you tell
them to me for her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，罗达弗里安女士
让我来问问你，
关于描述卢恩·米德加兹王国
建国的那首歌的歌词。
你能告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Rodafrian? Oh, she must
mean that old children's
song. How did it go now?
Ah, now I remember...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
罗达弗里安？哦，她指的
应该是那首老童谣吧。
歌词是怎么来着？
啊，我想起来了...

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
^FF0000*The great serpent*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the sea.*^000000
^FF0000*The eagle of the rainbow*^000000
^FF0000*swallowed the serpent.*^000000
^FF0000*Then snake scales grew on*^000000
^FF0000*the eagle, and it slowly died.*^000000

[Historian Mondo]
Yes, I know: the song
is rather morbid, despite
the fact that it's sung like
such a happy song. Sometimes
these little songs are supposed
to scare kids into doing good.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
是的，我知道：
这首歌虽然唱得很欢快，
内容却相当阴森。
有时候，
这些童谣就是为了吓唬小孩
让他们乖乖听话。

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Hm? You look confused.
Did you have a question
to ask me about the song?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
嗯？你看起来很困惑。
你是想问我关于这首歌的
什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I heard
a different version
of this song, so I was
wondering why the lyrics
would be different...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，
我听过这首歌的另一个版本，
所以我想知道
为什么歌词会不一样...

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Really now?
Well then, let me
hear the version that
you've heard, starting
from the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
真的吗？
那么，请把你听到的版本
从头到尾
念给我听听。

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Ah, would you tell me
the lyrics of the version of
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
founding myth song that
you happened to hear?
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
啊，你能告诉我
你偶然听到的
卢恩·米德加兹王国
建国神话歌曲的版本
的歌词吗？

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Interesting...
The version you heard
from Karlomoff is different
than the one I know. It's
possible that his version
is the most authentic.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
有意思...
你从卡尔莫夫那里听到的版本
和我知道的不一样。
有可能他的版本
才是最真实的。

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
After all, I learned
the version I know
by listening to a
little kid sing it.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
毕竟，
我听到的这个版本，
是听一个小孩子
唱出来的。

scripts.text: A kid?
scripts.translation: 小孩子？

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Yeah. My guess? The version
that the kid sang might have
changed as it was transmitted
by mouth through the generations. If you want to learn more, you
should probably find that kid.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
是的。我猜？
小孩子唱的版本
可能在口口相传的过程中
发生了变化。如果你想了解更多，
你应该去找那个小孩。

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Anyway, Karlomoff may have
the most accurate version of
the song since he's very good
at procuring and authenticating
historical written records and
documents. It's his specialty.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
总之，卡尔莫夫可能拥有
最准确的歌曲版本，
因为他非常擅长
收集和鉴定
历史文献和文件。这是他的专长。

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Ah, if you want to learn more,
then you should try to find the
kid that was singing the song.
Hmm, he might be around ^3131DDthe
river near here^000000. Hopefully it
won't be too hard to find him.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
啊，如果你想了解更多，
那么你应该试着去找
那个唱这首歌的小孩。
嗯，他可能在^3131DD附近的河边^000000。
希望能不难找到他。

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Once you're able to talk
to that kid, go ahead and
report back to Rodafrian.
She probably needs to know
soon, and I can talk to that
little kid at my leisure, so...
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
一旦你能和那个小孩交谈，
请回去向罗达弗里安汇报。
她可能很快就需要知道，
而我也可以在我方便的时候
和那个小孩子谈谈，所以...

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Well then, I hope you
find what you're looking
for. Good luck in your
travels, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家 蒙多]
那么，希望你能找到
你想要的答案。
旅途愉快，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Historian Mondo]
Isn't this such
a beautiful place?
It's no wonder that
ancient peoples chose
to live around here...
scripts.translation:

[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
Not too many people
come to this remote area.
What brings you all the
way over here, I wonder?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
来到这个偏远地区的人
并不多。
不知是什么风把你
吹到这里来了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

trying to learn the
real lyrics of that
song that little boy
has been singing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我只是想弄清楚
那个小男孩一直在唱的
那首歌的真正歌词。

scripts.text:
[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
.........

[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
That song's lyrics, and
its meaning, can change
from person to person as
time goes on. I suppose part
of the reason is because it's
been handed down orally...
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
那首歌的歌词和含义，
会随着时间推移，
因人而异。我想部分原因是
因为它是通过口口相传...
流传下来的...

scripts.text:
[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
It sounds like such a happy
song, but it's meaning had
changed for me ever since
the accident had happened...
It's been so long, but I don't
think the pain will ever heal.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
听起来像是一首快乐的歌，
但自那次事故发生后，
它的含义对我来说已经改变了...
虽然过去很久了，
但我觉得那份痛苦永远不会愈合。

scripts.text: Accident?
scripts.translation: 事故？

scripts.text:
[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
I'm... I'm sorry.
I don't think I can talk
about it. If I try, I know I'll
relive the horror. Every day
is already a struggle to cope
with the sins I've committed.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
我...我很抱歉。
我觉得我无法谈论这件事。
如果我尝试回忆，我知道我会再次经历那种恐惧。
每一天，我都在与自己所犯下的罪孽作斗争。

scripts.text:
[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
I know it's selfish, but
I have a favor to ask of you.
I can't really leave this area,
and seldom do I receive visitors. Would you be so kind to deliver
something to Prontera for me?
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
我知道这很自私，
但我有一个请求想拜托你。
我实在无法离开这个地方，
而且很少有人来访。你能否好心帮我送样东西到普隆德拉？

scripts.text:
[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
I used to live in Prontera,
and ever since the accident,
Father Bamph has been so very
supportive of me. It's not enough to repay his kindness, but please
give these herbs to him for me.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
我以前住在普隆德拉，
自从那次事故后，
班夫神父一直非常支持我。
这不足以报答他的恩情，
但请把这些草药交给他。

scripts.text:
[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
You can find ^3131FFFather Bamph^000000
in ^3131FFProntera Church^000000. When you 
see him, please give him my
warmest regards. I would do it
myself, but because of what I did, I can't return to Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
你可以在^3131FF普隆德拉教堂^000000找到^3131FF班夫神父^000000。
见到他时，请代我向他致以最诚挚的问候。
我自己想去，但因为我做过的事，我无法回到普隆德拉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(Alright then. I guess
I should deliver these
herbs to Prontera Church
before I talk to Rodafrian.)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333(好吧。我想在去找罗达夫里安之前，
先把这些草药送到普隆德拉教堂。)^000000

scripts.text:
[Exhausted-Looking Woman]
Father Bamph has helped
me so much. Please bring
that herb pouch to him in
Prontera Church, and give
him my warmest regards.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的女子]
班夫神父帮了我很多。
请把那袋草药带到普隆德拉教堂交给他，
并代我向他致以最诚挚的问候。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
Oh, you've come back?
Were you able to deliver
that pouch of herbs that
I gave you to Father Bamph?
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
哦，你回来了？
你把我给你的那袋草药
交给班夫神父了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I did. Actually,
Father Bamph sent me
here to ask you a few
things. You see, he told
me all about the royal secret
and, well, your exorcism.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我交了。其实，
是班夫神父派我来的，
想问你一些事情。你看，他告诉了我
关于王室秘密以及...你的驱魔仪式的事。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
Oh. I see.
You must think
me a monster...
Those poor children
are dead because of me...
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
哦。我明白了。
你一定觉得我是个怪物吧...
那些可怜的孩子
是因为我才死的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no! Not at all!
I just wanted to ask if there
was a connection between
the song that Kaanu has been
singing and Jormungand's curse.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...不！完全不是！
我只是想问问，卡阿努一直在唱的那首歌
和耶梦加得的诅咒之间
是否有联系。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
...
......
.........

[Bonnie Imbullea]
After the exorcism failed,
I should have been punished
with death. But the royal family and the Prontera Church took
mercy on me, and allowed
me to live here in exile.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
驱魔仪式失败后，
我应该被处以死刑。
但王室和普隆德拉教堂
对我网开一面，
允许我留在这里流放。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
I began to sing this song
to keep myself distracted,
even if it was related to
the Jormungand curse.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
我开始唱这首歌
来分散自己的注意力，
即使它与耶梦加得的诅咒有关。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
You know, now that I think
about it, I do remember hearing
that after the exorcism failed,
a maid found a fragment of a
Red Gemstone while cleaning
the secret ceremonial grounds.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
你知道吗，现在回想起来，
我记得在驱魔仪式失败后，
一名女仆在打扫秘密仪式场地时，
发现了一块红色魔力矿石的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
I always thought it
was a little strange.
I wanted to investigate
it, but then I was discharged
from the Prontera Church
after my failure...
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
我一直觉得这有点奇怪。
我想去调查一下，
但在我失败后，
我就被普隆德拉教堂解雇了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A fragment from
a Red Gemstone?
Maybe... maybe it's
evidence that someone
sabotaged the exorcism!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
红色魔力矿石的碎片？
也许...也许这是
有人破坏驱魔仪式的证据！

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
What happened was tragic,
but it would make me feel
so much better if that were
really the truth. Even if the
exorcism was sabotaged,
we can't turn back time...
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
发生的事很悲剧，
但如果那真的是事实，
我会感觉好受很多。
即使驱魔仪式被破坏了，
我们也无法让时间倒流...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(Hmm...
I better head back
to Prontera Church
and let Father Bamph
know about this information.)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333(嗯...
我最好回到普隆德拉教堂，
把这个消息告诉班夫神父。)^000000

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
It's really very
difficult to live
with this guilt.
I was trained to help
people, not kill them!
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
带着这种罪恶感生活
真的非常困难。
我是被训练来帮助人的，
而不是杀人！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tried to comfort
Bonnie Imbullea for a
little while before you
return to Prontera Church.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你安慰了邦妮·因布莉娅一会儿，
然后返回普隆德拉教堂。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Bonnie Imbullea
that the deaths of the princes
were not her fault and that the exorcism was probably sabotaged.
However, you keep specifics, like the use of poison, to yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你告诉邦妮·因布莉娅，王子的死不是她的错，驱魔仪式很可能被破坏了。
不过，你把使用毒药等具体细节隐瞒了下来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
Is that really true...?
Oh, I'm so happy! I really
thought I'd have to live the
rest of my in seclusion with
this horrible shame. Oh, thank
you so much for your help!
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
真的吗...？
太好了！我真的以为
自己得带着这份可耻的羞耻
在隐居中度完余生。
非常感谢你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
Kaanu will be able to
meet other kids his own
age... We can finally live
a normal life. How wonderful...
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
卡阿努终于可以
和其他同龄的孩子见面了...
我们终于可以过上
正常的生活了。真是太好了...

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
But wait...
How exactly did the
princes die, then?
There weren't any
wounds on the bodies
from what I remember...
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
但是等等...
那么王子们到底是怎么死的？
据我所知，尸体上
并没有任何伤口...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, um, I wouldn't know
anything about that, but
Father Bamph and Father
Biscuss are handling the
investigation, and they're
doing their best to find out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这个我也不太清楚，
不过班夫神父和
比库斯神父正在调查，
他们会尽力查明真相的。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
I see. Well, I believe in
them: they're great priests,
after all. Although I may be
forgiven for my failure, I still fear for the royal family...
All I can do for now is pray.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
我明白了。我相信他们，
毕竟他们是优秀的牧师。
虽然我的过失可能被原谅了，
但我仍然担心王室...
目前我能做的只有祈祷。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
Anyway, I promise that
I won't reveal what I know
about this incident to the
public. And if you ever come
by the mountain again, I hope
you stop by to visit us.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
总之，我保证不会
向公众透露我关于
这次事件的所知。
如果你以后再来山上，
欢迎来拜访我们。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
You don't understand
how much the news you've
brought really means to me.
I can finally free myself from
this burdensome guilt...
Thank you, kind adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
你不知道你带来的消息
对我意味着什么。
我终于可以从
这份沉重的罪恶感中解脱了...
谢谢你，善良的冒险者~

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow, you can return to
Rodafrian, the historian
stationed in Morocc.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF现在，你可以返回
驻扎在摩罗克的
历史学家罗达夫里安那里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
By your grace and mercy,
please pity the poor souls
and protect the royal family...
Bless us with your light and
may your wisdom guide us...
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
以您的恩典和怜悯，
请怜悯这些可怜的灵魂，
并保护王室...
愿您的光辉赐福于我们，
愿您的智慧指引我们...

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
I guess we've gotten
too used to the peace
and serenity of Mount
Mjolnir. It won't be easy
to leave, even if we're welcome to return to Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
我想我们已经太习惯
雷神之锤山的
宁静与祥和了。
即使我们可以回到普隆德拉，
离开这里也不容易...

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
Thank you so much
for helping out in the
investigation of the
princes. I'd never know
happiness again if it
weren't for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[邦妮·因布莉娅]
非常感谢你
协助调查王子的死因。
如果没有你的努力，
我可能再也无法感受到幸福了。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie Imbullea]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Father Bamph]
Welcome to
Prontera Church.
Please relax, and
let your mind and
spirit find rest in
these hallowed halls.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
欢迎来到
普隆德拉教堂。
请放松身心，
让心灵和灵魂
在这神圣的大厅中得到安息。

scripts.text: Give him the herb pouch.
scripts.translation: 给他那个草药袋

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ack!
Now, where did I put
that pouch with the herbs?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀！
我把那个装草药的袋子
放哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
May I ask...
Why are you giving
me this pouch of herbs?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
请问...
你为什么要把
这袋草药给我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, there was this
lady living on Mount
Mjolnir who wanted me
to give this to you. Um, she
has a son named Kaanu?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，有一位住在
雷神之锤山的女士
让我把这个交给你。
嗯，她有个儿子叫卡阿努？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Oh, you must have met
Bonnie Imbullea. It's
been a long time since
I've seen her. How is
she doing, may I ask?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
哦，你一定见过
邦妮·因布莉娅。
我已经很久没见她了。
她最近过得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh...
I guess she's fine.
But she seems really...
I dunno, tormented...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...
我想她过得还行。
但她看起来真的很...
我不知道怎么说，很痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Father Biscuss]
Good! If she were happy
and relaxed after what she
did, not even God would forgive
her! She deserves to live the
rest of her life in agony!
scripts.translation:
[比斯库斯神父]
很好！如果她在做完那些事之后还能感到快乐和放松，那连上帝都不会原谅她！她余生都该在痛苦中度过！

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Father Biscuss, how can
you say something like that?
She did her best to stop what
had happened! We should pity
her for the suffering she must be feeling. Where is your compassion?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
比斯库斯神父，你怎么能说出这种话？她已经尽力阻止事情发生了！我们应该怜悯她此刻所承受的痛苦。你的同情心在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Father Biscuss]
Bah! Don't speak to me
about compassion! Weren't
you the one who recommended
her to perform the exorcism in
the first place? You didn't
forget that, did you?
scripts.translation:
[比斯库斯神父]
哼！别跟我提什么同情心！当初推荐她去执行驱魔仪式的人不就是你吗？你不会忘了吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Biscuss]
Hah!
scripts.translation:
[比斯库斯神父]
哈！

scripts.text: About Bonnie Imbullea
scripts.translation: 关于邦妮·因布莉娅

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Well...
I don't...
I don't know if
I should be telling 
you about that incident...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
嗯...
我...
我不确定是否应该告诉你关于那件事的情况...

scripts.text:
[Father Biscuss]
You know what? If Bonnie
sent this adventurer here
for a favor, it probably means
she trusts this person. Besides, we need somebody to carry out
this task for us. Why not him?
scripts.translation:
[比斯库斯神父]
你知道吗？如果邦妮派这位冒险者来帮忙，那大概意味着她信任这个人。况且，我们需要有人替我们执行这项任务。为什么不让他来呢？

scripts.text:
[Father Biscuss]
You know what? If Bonnie
sent this adventurer here
for a favor, it probably means
she trusts this person. Besides, we need somebody to carry out
this task for us. Why not her?
scripts.translation:
[比斯库斯神父]
你知道吗？如果邦妮派这位冒险者来帮忙，那大概意味着她信任这个人。况且，我们需要有人替我们执行这项任务。为什么不让她来呢？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Your words have the ring
of truth, Father Biscuss.
Well then, adventurer, give
me the opportunity to tell you
something very important. But, you must not tell anyone else...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
你说得很有道理，比斯库斯神父。
那么，冒险者，请给我一个机会，让我告诉你一件非常重要的事。但是，你绝对不能告诉任何人...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
What I am about to tell
you must be kept secret.
Now, do you know about
Jormungand, the great serpent
born from the god Loki and
the giantess, Angrboda?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
我接下来要告诉你的事必须保密。
现在，你知道耶梦加得吗？那是由神洛基和女巨人安格波达所生的巨蛇。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Jormungand was an evil
beast that, after the thousand
year war between the gods and
demons, began to attack humans.
It brought great chaos and much
suffering around the world...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
耶梦加得是一只邪恶的野兽，在神与恶魔之间长达千年的战争结束后，它开始攻击人类。
它在世界各地带来了巨大的混乱和痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Finally, the first Tristram of
the Geoborg family defeated
Jormungand together with 6
other warriors, but only after
it killed his beloved father.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
最终，吉奥伯格家族的第一位特里斯特兰，与其他六名战士一起击败了耶梦加得，但那是在它杀死了他深爱的父亲之后。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Tristram would become the
first king of the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom, but his family would
suffer from the curse placed
by Jormungand before its defeat.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
特里斯特兰成为了卢恩·米德加兹王国的第一位国王，但他的家族却遭受了耶梦加得在被击败前施加的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
To this day...
^FF0000Every first prince of
the Geoborg family dies
at a young age^000000. That is
Jormungand's curse and
the royal family's secret.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
直到今天...
^FF0000吉奥伯格家族的每一位长子都在年幼时死去^000000。这就是耶梦加得的诅咒，也是王室的秘密。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?!
Is this really true?!
Isn't there any way to
counter this horrible curse?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么...？！
这是真的吗？！
难道没有任何方法可以解除这个可怕的诅咒吗？！

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Please lower your voice.
Yes, it's a shame that the
royal family must suffer like
this. But all the exorcisms
that have been attempted
over the years have failed...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
请小声一点。
是的，王室必须遭受这样的痛苦，这确实令人遗憾。但多年来尝试过的所有驱魔仪式都失败了...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Although the situation
appeared hopeless, King
Tristram III tried once again to exorcise the curse. Following
his orders, the greatest priests and exorcists were all summoned.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
虽然局势看似无望，但特里斯特兰三世国王还是再次尝试解除诅咒。按照他的命令，最强大的牧师和驱魔师都被召集了起来。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
A series of tests was
performed to select the
best priests and exorcists
to remove this curse. In the end, ^3131FFBonnie Imbullea^000000 was chosen to
lead the exorcism ceremony.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
为了选出能解除此诅咒的最佳牧师和驱魔师，进行了一系列测试。最终，^3131FF邦妮·因布莉娅^000000被选中来主持驱魔仪式。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, but you mentioned
samething about an accident.
Does that mean that she failed
in performing the exorcism?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你刚才提到了什么事故。
那是不是说她在执行驱魔仪式时失败了？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Yes, unfortunately.
After the priests and
exorcists gathered in the
secret ceremonial grounds,
three princes were killed
instead of just the first.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
是的，不幸的是。
当牧师和驱魔师聚集在秘密仪式场地后，
原本只该牺牲的第一王子，
结果三位王子都死了。

scripts.text:
[Father Biscuss]
Although we all swore to
keep that incident a secret,
Bonnie Imbullea took full
responsibility for the deaths.
That is why she is in self
imposed exile from the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[比斯库斯神父]
虽然我们大家都发誓要保守这个秘密，
但邦妮·因布莉娅主动承担了所有死亡的责任。
这也是她为何自我放逐，离开了王国。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?
That's...
That's crazy!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么...？
这...
这也太疯狂了！

scripts.text:
[Father Biscuss]
I know that this
is a very long story,
and that it's a little
complicated. Please
listen to what we have
to ask from here on...
scripts.translation:
[比斯库斯神父]
我知道这故事很长，
而且有点复杂。
请听我们接下来要请求你的事...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Now, you should know that
all of the princes that were
killed that day bore strange
looking marks on their bodies.
It almost looked as if they
were growing snake scales.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
现在，你应该知道，
那天被杀的所有王子身上
都有奇怪的痕迹。
看起来就像长出了蛇鳞一样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, they grew snake
scales? That sounds just
like one of the versions of
this song I'm investigating.
I think it was the song about the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom's origin.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，他们长出了蛇鳞？
这听起来就像我正在调查的
那首歌的某个版本。
我想那是关于卢恩·米德加兹王国起源的歌。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Wait, that song?
Hm, I don't see how
it's related. Let's see
now, how did it go?
Rainbows... Eagles...
Ah! Now I remember!
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
等等，那首歌？
嗯，我不觉得这有什么关系。
让我想想，歌词是怎么唱的？
彩虹...鹰...
啊！我想起来了！

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
The great serpent
swallowed the sea.
The eagle of the rainbow
swallowed the serpent.
Then the eagle built its nest.
A nest upon the swallowed sea.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
巨蛇吞没了大海。
彩虹之鹰吞没了巨蛇。
然后鹰筑起了巢。
一个建立在被吞没的大海之上的巢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
Well, I heard a
different version
of the same song.
It goes like...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...
我听过同一首歌的不同版本。
歌词是这样的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The great serpent
swallowed the sea.
The eagle of the rainbow
swallowed the serpent.
Then snake scales grew on
the eagle, and it slowly died.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
巨蛇吞没了大海。
彩虹之鹰吞没了巨蛇。
然后鹰身上长出了蛇鳞，
它慢慢死去了。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Oh, my. I learned the song
when I was a young boy from
my father. However, your version seems to reveal the secret curse
of the Geoborgs. Please tell me, where did you hear that song?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
天哪。我小时候
是从父亲那里学会这首歌的。
不过，你的版本似乎揭示了
吉奥堡家族的诅咒秘密。
请告诉我，你在哪里听到这首歌的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I first heard this
version from a historian,
and then I found out that
Bonnie Imbullea knows it as
well. Um, is there a problem?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我最初是从一位历史学家那里
听到这个版本的，
然后我发现邦妮·因布莉娅
也知道这首歌。呃，有什么问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
If those song lyrics are
spread, the secret of the
royal family curse could be
revealed to the public. Would
you please help us by speaking
to Bonnie Imbullea once again?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
如果这些歌词流传出去，
王室诅咒的秘密可能会暴露给公众。
你能否再次去见邦妮·因布莉娅，
帮我们一个忙？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
If you can, please try to
see if you can learn of any
connection between the curse
and the song, or if she can
remember anything that happened
after the exorcism failed...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
如果可以的话，请试着
看看你能否了解到诅咒与歌曲之间的联系，
或者她是否记得驱魔仪式失败后
发生的任何事...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Please visit Bonnie
Imbullea in Mount Mjolnir
to see if you can learn more
about that song, or about what
happened after the attempted exorcism of the Jormungand curse.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
请去雷神之锤山拜访邦妮·因布莉娅，
看看你能否了解更多关于那首歌的事，
或者关于尝试解除耶梦加得诅咒后发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Ah, have you spoken
to Bonnie Imbullea?
Please tell me if you
have learned anything new.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
啊，你和邦妮·因布莉娅谈过了吗？
如果你了解到任何新情况，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou related everything
that Bonnie Imbullea spoke
about, including the discovery
of a fragment of Red Gemstone
in the secret ceremonial grounds.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你详细讲述了邦妮·因布莉娅所说的一切，包括在秘密仪式场地发现红色魔力矿石碎片一事。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Red Gemstone? There's
no reason for that to be in
a holy place. Hmm. There's
more to this case than meets
the eye. We better investigate
the truth, starting now.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
红色魔力矿石？它出现在神圣之地是没有理由的。
嗯。这件事比表面看起来更复杂。
我们最好从现在开始调查真相。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Come with me, adventurer,
to the secret ceremonial
grounds for the royal family.
Just use the switch hidden
within the bookshelf and
I will meet you there.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
跟我来，冒险者，
去王室的秘密仪式场地。
只需使用书架里隐藏的开关，
我会在哪里等你。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Come with me to the
secret ceremonial grounds
so that we can investigate
the possibility of sabotage
with the exorcism that
Bonnie Imbullea performed.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
跟我来，去秘密仪式场地，
以便我们调查邦妮·因布莉娅执行的驱魔仪式
是否有人蓄意破坏的可能性。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
There is a hidden switch
in the bookshelf that you
can use to transport yourself
there. Go, and I will meet
you in the ceremonial grounds.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
书架里有一个隐藏的开关，
你可以用它传送过去。
去吧，我会在仪式场地等你。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
This is a matter of grave
importance, but we can't
alert the royal family yet and
cause a panic. It would be
best to fully investigate this
first and collect proof.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
这是一件极其严重的事情，
但我们还不能惊动王室，以免引起恐慌。
最好先彻底调查此事并收集证据。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Brave adventurer, would
you please visit the Assassin
Guild in Morocc and see if you
can learn anything about how
we can verify whether poison
was used to kill the princes?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
勇敢的冒险者，
请去莫洛克的刺客公会，
看看能否查明如何验证
是否有人用毒药杀害了王子们？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Please see if you can
learn anything about testing
for the use of poison from
a member of the Assassin
Guild in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
请去莫洛克的刺客公会，
向成员打听一下
如何检测是否使用了毒药。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Ah, you've returned~
Have you managed to learn
anything about poison from
the Assassin Guild? I know
their members must be
very difficult to find...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
啊，你回来了~
你从刺客公会那里
了解到关于毒药的事情了吗？
我知道他们的成员
一定很难找到...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou relate all of the
information you learned
about poison to Father Bamph,
including the method to test
for the use of poison in murder.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向班夫神父汇报了所有关于毒药的信息，
包括如何检测谋杀中是否使用了毒药。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Ah, I see. Then, would
you please bring 1 Yellow
Gemstone and 1 Green Potion
to the secret ceremonial grounds as soon as you can? I will wait
over there for you once again.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
啊，我明白了。那么，
请尽快带1个黄色魔力矿石
和1瓶绿色药水到秘密仪式场地。
我会再次在那里等你。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
You can use the hidden
switch in the bookshelf to
enter the secret ceremonial
grounds. Don't forget that we
need^3131FF 1 Yellow Gemstone^000000 and ^3131FF1 Green Potion^000000 to test for poison.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
你可以使用书架里的隐藏开关
进入秘密仪式场地。
别忘了我们需要^3131FF1个黄色魔力矿石^000000和^3131FF1瓶绿色药水^000000来检测毒药。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
I can't believe it!
If poison was used, then
the second and third princes
were murdered! Unbelievable...
How can anyone kill children?
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
难以置信！
如果使用了毒药，
那么第二和第三王子就是被谋杀的！
太不可思议了...
怎么能杀害孩子呢？

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
At the very least, we now
know that their deaths were
not Bonnie Imbullea's fault.
Now I must discuss with Father
Biscuss and decide how to tell
the royal family about this...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
至少，我们现在知道
他们的死不是邦妮·因布莉娅的错。
现在我必须和比斯库斯神父商量，
决定如何告知王室这件事...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Once again, let me remind
you that everything that has
transpired here must be kept
secret. The public cannot know
of Jormungand's curse! It would cause political turmoil and chaos!
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
再次提醒你，
这里发生的一切必须保密。
公众不能知道耶梦加得的诅咒！
那会引起政治动荡和混乱！

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Still, that does not mean
that I cannot personally thank
you for all of your help. I'm very grateful for what you have done,
adventurer. May safety accompany you on all of your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
不过，这并不妨碍我
亲自感谢你的所有帮助。
非常感谢你所做的一切，冒险者。
愿平安伴随你所有的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
I'm at a loss at what
to do. Sometimes, even
I have doubts and believe
that Odin has abandoned us...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
我不知所措。
有时候，连我自己都怀疑，
觉得奥丁已经抛弃了我们...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Ah, you've returned~
Have you managed to learn
anything about poison from
the Assassin Guild? I know
their members must be
very difficult to find...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
啊，你回来了~
你从刺客公会那里
了解到关于毒药的事情了吗？
我知道他们的成员
一定很难找到...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou relate all of the
information you learned
about poison to Father Bamph,
including the method to test
for the use of poison in murder.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向班夫神父汇报了所有关于毒药的信息，
包括如何检测谋杀中是否使用了毒药。

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Ah, I see. Then, would
you please bring^3131FF 1 Yellow
Gemstone^000000 and ^3131FF1 Green Potion^000000
to the secret ceremonial grounds as soon as you can? I will wait
over there for you once again.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
啊，我明白了。那么，
请尽快带^3131FF1个黄色魔力矿石^000000和^3131FF1瓶绿色药水^000000
到秘密仪式场地。
我会再次在那里等你。

决定如何告知王室这件事...

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Oh, and would you please
inform ^3131FFBonnie Imbullea^000000 that
the deaths of the princes were
not her fault? I'm sure that news would bring her great relief
from her burden of guilt...
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
哦，还有，请告诉^3131FF邦妮·因布莉娅^000000
王子的死不是她的错。
我相信这个消息
能让她从愧疚的重担中解脱出来...

you that everything that has
transpired here must be kept
secret. The public cannot know

scripts.text:
[Father Bamph]
Have you spoken to
Bonnie Imbullea yet?
Try not to worry about the
news about the princes'
murder. Father Biscuss
and I will handle it.
scripts.translation:
[班夫神父]
你和邦妮·因布莉娅谈过了吗？
不要担心关于王子被谋杀的消息。
比斯库斯神父和我会处理这件事。

information you learned
about poison to Father Bamph,

scripts.translation:

都告诉了班夫神父，
包括检测谋杀中是否使用毒药的方法。

you please bring ^3131FF1 Yellow

over there for you once again.
